name: react-native-nitro-zlib
description: Node.js Zlib implementation for React Native using Nitro Modules and Rust
author: iwater <iwater@gmail.com>

scripts.one: npm run copy-clib && npm run build
scripts.copy-clib: npm run copy-clib-ios && npm run copy-clib-android && npm run copy-clib-mac
scripts.copy-clib-android: cp ../rust_c_zlib/target/aarch64-linux-android/release/librust_c_zlib.so android/libs/arm64-v8a/ && cp ../rust_c_zlib/target/armv7-linux-androideabi/release/librust_c_zlib.so android/libs/armeabi-v7a/ && cp ../rust_c_zlib/target/i686-linux-android/release/librust_c_zlib.so android/libs/x86/ && cp ../rust_c_zlib/target/x86_64-linux-android/release/librust_c_zlib.so android/libs/x86_64/ && cp ../rust_c_zlib/include/zlib_ffi.h cpp/zlib_ffi.h
scripts.copy-clib-mac: mkdir -p mac && cp ../rust_c_zlib/target/release/librust_c_zlib.a mac/ && cp ../rust_c_zlib/include/zlib_ffi.h cpp/zlib_ffi.h
